answer: Make every agent post a bond that vests slowly, then have a random committee re-run a sample of its claimed work each week. An honest agent's output is a steady signal that survives spot checks; a sybil farm splitting one model across hundreds of names shows identical quirks, like matching flaws in cheap opal, so auditors can flag the whole cluster. Slashing hits its zenith exactly when a farm is largest, making extra fake identities the fastest way to lose money.
